item.title: Elon Musk invents the mattress sale
item.description: Eleven-dimensional chess player Elon Musk has unveiled a bold new pricing innovation this week: the limited-time offer. Telling customers the price will go up if they don't buy right now is a breakthrough retail strategy long thought to be exclusive to Presidents' Day mattress sales and going-out-of-business sofa emporiums. — Read the rest The post Elon Musk invents the mattress sale appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: White House posts "Trump Right About Everything" report, peer-reviewed by the voices in his head
item.description: The White House has published a sweeping new economic analysis concluding that convicted felon Donald Trump is, as usual, correct about everything. item.title: Michael Stipe returns to The Simpsons with "Everybody Kirks"

item.title: These intricate "phantom" leaves from 1864 look like delicate lace Cut-Outs Preserved in Time
item.description: These images of skeletonized leaves from 1864 are intricate masterpieces. They come from a treatise called Phantom Flowers, which described the art of stripping away a leaf's tissue to reveal only its vein structure — producing something that looks like extremely detailed lace. — Read the rest The post These intricate "phantom" leaves from 1864 look like delicate lace Cut-Outs Preserved in Time appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: This website tells you whether your food is still safe to eat
item.description: Ever stare at something in your fridge and try to decide whether it's worth the gamble? DoesItLast is a website that gives you the FDA/USDA guidelines on when food goes bad. item.title: Psilocybin trial shows six months of depression relief from one dose
item.description: One or two doses of psilocybin provided six months of relief from depression that nothing else could touch, in two late-stage clinical trials of Comp360. British biotech Compass Pathways announced the findings on February 17th, according to The Economist. David Erritzoe at Imperial College called it "very good news for psychedelic therapies." — Read the rest The post Psilocybin trial shows six months of depression relief from one dose appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: OpenAI CEO reduces childhood to a power bill
item.description: On again off again OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, who famously claimed he could not raise a child without AI, now sums up the meaning of life as the carbon footprint of training an LLM. Altman compared 20 years of growth, learning, scraped knees, and bedtime stories to the electricity bill for training a large language model, concluding that people are basically very slow, snack-powered neural networks. — Read the rest The post OpenAI CEO reduces childhood to a power bill appeared first on Boing Boing.
